$comment: Canonical planner-sync fixtures — the cross-repo arbiter for base-studio-code and mobile-studio-code. Both TS tests (src/__tests__/plannerCore.test.ts) and Rust tests (src-tauri/src/tunnel.rs) validate their implementations against these values. See src/lib/plannerCore/ for the TS implementation. Any change here is a BREAKING PROTOCOL CHANGE and must be coordinated across both repos.

parity.fnv1a_precision: Math.imul(h, 0x01000193) >>> 0; Rust: h.wrapping_mul(0x01000193); both hash UTF-8 bytes
parity.issue_id_note: Desktop PlanIssue.ref maps to the canonical 'id' field at the bridge serialization boundary. The values are identical — the bridge renames, not transforms.

section_state_vocab.note: Desktop sections absent from planSections map to nothing (not in canonical). Sections in planSections but not confirmedSections are 'drafted'. Sections in _skipped.md become state 'skipped'.

fnv1a32.$comment: Standard FNV-1a 32-bit test vectors (hashing UTF-8 bytes). Both implementations must produce these exact hex strings.

manifest.$comment: Example manifest: goal.md contains 'foobar' (hash bf9cf968), phases.json contains 'a' (hash e40c292c)

wireFrames.$comment: Canonical wire frame shapes for the plan_sync_* protocol frames. camelCase field names on the wire (Rust: #[serde(rename_all = 'camelCase')]). Tagged by snake_case 'type' field.
